verdicts.quote: Automatic promotion, no claim window. The oldest eligible waiter is booked the moment a spot frees; no accept/decline step and no timer.

order is join order per class (AD-2)... R-2.c boundary: order is by server sequence, not request arrival time claimed by the client; R-1 out of scope: priority tiers; R-3 out of scope: manual staff promotion
Out of scope here (bounded by this R): ... joining several overlapping classes' waitlists (no clash check is added)
verdicts.missing: What happens to a member's entry on an overlapping class once they are promoted into the other; the spec adds no clash check and does not resolve the second entry.

verdicts.quote: Out of scope: claim window / accept-decline offers (A-1); ... refunds or penalties.
verdicts.missing: Whether an automatic promotion the member then cancels late or no-shows counts against the existing no-show/late-cancellation policy.

verdicts.quote: whenever the booked count drops below capacity ... by a member cancelling their booking, a staff removal of an attendee, or a capacity increase — the system, in the same atomic unit (AD-1, AD-3), books the oldest Waiting entry
Outbound notification of promotion and removal uses an existing channel if one exists (AD-7, G-4). ... a failed notification send never reverses a promotion; it is logged (R-12).
verdicts.missing: Which channel is used (left open as G-4) and what the outbound message says.

verdicts.quote: all operations on one class serialize (AD-1)... I-2: booked count ≤ capacity; R-3: Promotion never exceeds capacity.
A member who already has a Waiting entry directly booking → ALREADY_WAITLISTED. (with R-10: all operations on one class serialize)

G-3 — if booking consumes a prepaid credit or charges a payment instrument, whether automatic promotion may do that ... needs an owner decision ... Interim: those classes are excluded from the waitlist
verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking and what happens when the charge fails; only an interim exclusion of paid classes is given.

verdicts.quote: No cap on waitlist length. The only bound is the natural one: one Waiting entry per member per class (R-1.d). Waitlist size therefore ≤ number of distinct members.
A free spot while B is false → no promotion (the spot stays free; entries are closed by R-6).
A capacity increase of k promotes up to k entries. ... I-2: booked count ≤ capacity, except where staff lower capacity below the booked count (existing behaviour, untouched).
Removed(CLASS_CANCELLED) when staff cancel the class. Joining after either → BOOKING_CLOSED / CLASS_CANCELLED (R-1).
Waitlist entry (class, member, sequence, status, reason) ... Position, waiting count | derived at read | the member | not stored
Ended entries are kept (not deleted) while the class record exists, and shown to the member until the class's start time passes. No new retention period is introduced.
a member sees only their own entries, their position and the anonymous waiting count — never another member's name, id or entry.
Staff visibility of waiters is out of scope. (R-3 out of scope: manual staff promotion; R-12 records waitlist.promoted with an opaque member id)
verdicts.missing: A staff view of the waitlist, staff manual promote/remove, and a staff-readable record of who was promoted when; only an audit log event exists.

verdicts.quote: Promotion runs inside the transaction of the operation that freed capacity. (R-3: in the same atomic unit (AD-1, AD-3), books the oldest Waiting entry)
classes that are not full, booking, cancelling a booking, capacity enforcement and the existing cut-off rules behave as before
